metadata.text:
[Unit]
Description=Reserve OCI instance metadata for root and controller on ts-auth hosts
Before=terrascale-orchestrator-host.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
# The nft file replaces the owned table. Seed it on first boot so its
# destroy command is valid without touching any unrelated table.
ExecStartPre=/bin/sh -c '/usr/sbin/nft list table inet terrascale_metadata >/dev/null 2>&1 || /usr/sbin/nft add table inet terrascale_metadata'
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/nft -f /etc/terrascale-orchestrator/ts-auth-metadata.nft
RemainAfterExit=no
# Returning inactive reapplies the rules on every host start, not just boot.
# Stopping this unit must not remove the metadata block.

[Install]
RequiredBy=terrascale-orchestrator-host.service

// Entry binds one logical product cell to its OCI region identifier.
type Entry struct {
	// Cell is the upper-case product region code, for example GRU.
	Cell string
	// OCIRegion is the canonical OCI region identifier, for example sa-saopaulo-1.
	OCIRegion string
	// OCIRegionKey is the OCI region key a tenancy subscribes with, for
	// example SJC for us-sanjose-1; it differs from the product cell code.
	OCIRegionKey string
	// City, Country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), Latitude and Longitude are display
	// metadata for operator views (the dashboard world map) and the cell's
	// Atlas region entry. They authorize nothing.
	City                string
	Country             string
	Latitude, Longitude float64
}

// Name is the lower-case cell token used in NATS subjects and host descriptors.
func (e Entry) Name() string { return strings.ToLower(e.Cell) }

	Bootstrap = GRU
)
